description.text: Demon is a 3D design and print from 2024. It was modeled as a sculptural form and is available as a digital file.
A skull modeled from scratch in Blender, 3D printed in PLA and hand-painted in nickel-toned acrylics. A digital file is available.

A collaborative installation and video about electronic waste. Discarded technology from illegal dumps sits alongside natural materials in a forest by a river. At the center is a CD case marked “Save me” and a disc titled “Strange Nature.”
Freehand pencil drawings on 50 × 70 cm Schoeller paper.
A portrait of Poseidon in bold colors with gold details. Painted on cardboard in acrylic, gouache and watercolor, with gold leaf and varnish.
A group project from the five-day i-Thea workshop. It developed graphic materials for the route linking the ancient theaters of Epirus in Dodona, Nicopolis, Kassope and Gitana.
A group university project for a fictional exhibition. The catalog explores the idea of human traces through modern, abstract design.
A catalog and teaser for a fictional exhibition, produced as a group university project using experimental graphics and contemporary visual storytelling.
A group project that created a visual identity for the Department of Culture, Creative Media and Industries, including its logo, color palette and brand applications.
Custom-fit phone cases painted by hand in acrylics. A durable protective varnish helps preserve the finish and colors.

A collaborative photographic series exploring gender and sexual fluidity through performance. A man in drag makeup is the central figure in four parts covering childhood, adulthood, military service and the afterlife.
